prompt:
Bamboo, the HerbLens panda mascot, in his signature canonical chibi design, shown deep in thought. He is seated on his haunches with his round tummy forward, one paw lifted to rest beneath his chin in a classic 'hmm' pondering pose. His eyes glance up and to the upper-right, big glossy black with ONE crisp symmetric white highlight each, as if tracing an idea floating in the air. Gentle closed-mouth smile, lips slightly pressed. Pink blush circles on both cheeks unchanged. A single small charcoal question mark '?' floats softly in the air a short distance above and to the right of his head — same charcoal color as his ear markings, slightly transparent so it reads as a thought. One small bamboo-leaf tip peeks from behind each ear.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern app-mascot illustration, like a premium iOS app icon. Flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradient shading (2-3 shade steps, airbrushed falloff). NO painterly brushstrokes, NO paper grain, NO watercolor texture, NO sketchy lines. Silhouette reads at thumbnail size. Subtle darker ambient-occlusion contour under arms and belly, NO hard black outline. Warm single-source light from upper left. Character plus floating question mark together occupy about 75 percent of frame height, centered, with comfortable margins. Must read as the same Bamboo character as the canonical reference.
